dashboard.purpose: Low-volume, brandable, luxury-feel OS&E guest supplies

items.name: Thick, engraveable wood hanger

constraints.brandable: Smooth wood shoulder face for in-house laser engraving
constraints.low_volume: Minimum order 1-25 units, US in-stock (no overseas MOQ)
constraints.price: Low cost preferred; quality is the floor. No hard cap given.
constraints.must_be: Heavy / thick / bulky so it is unlikely to be taken; currently available

options.product: Contoured Deluxe Wood Suit Hanger w/ Non-Slip Bar - Walnut
options.engraving: Beech engraves cleanly; walnut tone gives an understated tonal burn (matches Badrutt's crest look).
options.why: Best balance: genuinely thick/heavy, warm walnut suits the ranch, 3-pack MOQ ideal for testing in-house laser.

options.product: Tailor Made® Coat Hanger - Deep Butterscotch + Brass
options.pricing_terms: Sold individually; standard Butler 'Coat Hanger' from $27 ea
options.size: 16.5 in or 18 in; 2-5/8 in sculpted shoulder
options.hook: Solid brass (also walnut-espresso + matte chrome option)
options.engraving: Smooth German beech is a premium laser substrate; butterscotch gives refined medium-contrast.
options.why: Closest match to the Badrutt's hanger - heirloom weight, brass hook, warm wood. Buy one to prototype.

options.product: Contoured Suit Hanger w/ Locking Bar - Natural
options.size: 17 in; 1/2 in thick (slimmer than the Deluxe)
options.engraving: Light natural wood = highest logo contrast (crisp dark burn).
options.why: Lowest cost per unit and sharpest engraving; trade-off is a slimmer profile.

runner_ups.notes: 2.5 in shoulder flare, finishes incl. Natural, felted trouser bar; premium, sold singly.

runner_ups.product: Natural Royal Heirloom Wooden Suit Hanger
runner_ups.notes: Solid maple, smooth multi-coat lacquer, non-slip pant bar; lowest price, smooth face, slim 7/16 in.

runner_ups.product: Contoured Suit Hanger w/ Non-Slip Bar - Natural
runner_ups.notes: Same thick 18 in / 2 in deluxe profile as the primary pick but pricier per unit; good if you want just one or two.
German beech, 4 widths; lower-cost entry to Butler heirloom quality.

engraving_guidance: Highest contrast: natural / clear-finish maple, beech or birch (crisp dark burn on light wood).
Badrutt's look: medium/warm tones (walnut, butterscotch) give an understated tonal burn.
Avoid heavy gloss-poly or painted coatings; satin lacquer or natural is ideal (all picks qualify).
Placement: flat front shoulder face, ~1.5-2 in logo (where Badrutt's sets its crest).
Prototype on the 3-pack to lock laser power/speed before a full run.

lines: 1 x Butler Luxury single (~$27-38) to compare heirloom weight

roadmap.target: Well under $5/ea, laser or UVDTF, low MOQ
